title: Understanding Generative AI Risks for Youth: A Taxonomy Based on Empirical Data

bias_targets.methodology: Inductive thematic analysis of AI incident databases, Reddit discussions, and curated chat logs to identify instances of stereotyping (e.g., underrepresentation of Black professionals in leadership roles generated by Midjourney) and the presence of racial slurs in training data.

Inductive thematic analysis of AI incident databases, Reddit discussions, and curated chat logs to extract instances of implicitly biased datasets and outputs containing gendered insults targeting female individuals.

Inductive thematic analysis of AI incident databases, Reddit discussions, and curated chat logs to identify hateful, extremist, or derogatory chatbot responses triggered by terms related to sexual identity (e.g., the term "lesbian").
